title: One-block recurrence for acceptance value
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic machine over Boolean symbols, let $x$ be a Boolean input, let $T,i,c$ be natural numbers, and let $v$ be a Boolean. Write $p$ for the fraction of length-$T$ choice strings on which $N$ outputs exactly $[\mathrm{true}]$. Then the fraction of length-$(i+1)T$ choice strings for which the decision function applied to $c$ plus the number of accepting blocks among the first $i+1$ blocks equals $v$ is $p$ times the corresponding fraction for $i$ blocks with offset $c+1$, plus $(1-p)$ times that fraction with offset $c$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic machine $N$ over Boolean symbols
